title: Negative R-squared Root Cause Checklist
description: Machine-readable per-cause triage checklist. Phase 2 will run these checks top-down (priority order) against Wf-32 m16 / Wf-37 L5 / Wf-39 composite / Wf-25 Hilbert joint to localize the regression mechanism.

causes.title: Baseline issue: model predicts all mean (R2 less than 0)
causes.summary: Model output has near-zero variance — predictor collapsed to mean.

check_method.step_1: Compute y_train.mean(), y_test.mean(); confirm within 0.1 * std(y_train).
check_method.step_2: Compute pred_test.std() and pred_test.mean(). Flag if pred_test.std() < 0.1 * y_test.std().
check_method.step_3: Compare R^2(model) vs R^2(constant_mean). If R^2(model) < 0, model is worse than mean.

mitigations: Replace model head with Linear(dim, 1) + identity (no sigmoid, no clamp).
Inspect Hilbert tile-inflate; replace tile(8,8) with pad(8,64) + learned bias col.
Confirm loss is MSE (not BCE) for regression targets.

causes.title: Feature mismatch: features not informative for target
causes.summary: Train R^2 much greater than test R^2; features carry no transferable signal.

known_hits.note: 8-d RDKit against noisy binary; no electronic descriptors.
AST branch 12-d RDKit against NCI-60 pIC50; AST symbol library too narrow.

check_method.step_1: Per-feature Spearman rho with y_train. Flag if max |rho| < 0.05.
check_method.step_2: Train ridge regressor; flag train_R^2 - test_R^2 > 0.3.
check_method.step_3: Re-train with shuffled targets (y_shuf = y_train[randperm]). Flag if shuffled R^2 ~ real R^2.

causes.diagnostic_code: from scipy.stats import spearmanr; max_rho = max(abs(spearmanr(X_train[:, i], y_train)[0]) for i in range(X_train.shape[1]))
mitigations: Add 3D-aware features: asphericity, radius_of_gyration, PMI (after MMFF94s conformer).
Add electronic descriptors: HOMO, LUMO, Gap, Polarizability (PlatinAI schema).
Widen ASTSR symbol library: sin, cos, exp, log, sqrt, sigmoid.

causes.title: Target normalization reversed: should be max minus pic50, not reverse
causes.summary: y_pred sign-flip vs y_test; or train/test mean centering mismatch.

known_hits.note: Original target was binary {0,1} + N(0,0.05); Wf-37 swapped to real pIC50 [3.5, 9.5] continuous.

check_method.step_1: Print y_train.mean(), y_test.mean(), y_pred.mean(); confirm on same scale.
check_method.step_2: If (y_pred - y_test).mean() / y_test.std() > 0.5, model is biased not unstable.
check_method.step_3: If np.corrcoef(y_pred, y_test)[0,1] ~ -1.0, model learned wrong sign.

mitigations: Pin conversion at loader: pIC50 = -log10(IC50_M) consistently.
Compute y_train.mean() once; apply (y - y_mean) before training; use same y_mean at test.
If regression target bounded [a,b], normalise to [0,1] (not [-1,1]); inverse at eval.

causes.title: Data leakage: train set leak into test (scaffold split not strict)
causes.summary: Train and test scaffolds overlap; or cohort mismatch makes test OOD.

known_hits.note: Train PlatinAI 4-cell (synthetic IC50 from HOMO/LUMO); test HeLa48h/dark (real measurements) — different scaffolds, different target distributions.

check_method.step_1: Verify split is scaffold_split (Bemis-Murcko) not random_split.
check_method.step_2: Compute train-test scaffold overlap = len(set(train_scaffold) & set(test_scaffold)) / len(test_scaffold). Flag if > 0.
check_method.step_3: Compute KL(train_y || test_y). Flag if > 0.5 nats — test target out-of-distribution.

causes.diagnostic_code: from scipy.stats import entropy; kl = entropy(np.histogram(y_train, bins=20)[0] + 1e-10, np.histogram(y_test, bins=20)[0] + 1e-10)
mitigations: Re-split with strict scaffold_split (Bemis-Murcko grouped; train/val/test disjoint at scaffold level).
Re-run on dual cohorts: train on PlatinAI 4-cell + HeLa48h; test on held-out cohort disjoint by scaffold.
Remove overlapping molecules if scaffold overlap detected pre-split.

causes.title: Target distribution extreme: most pIC50 concentrated, model predict mean
causes.summary: Heavy mode near mean; upper-tail variance unexplained; regressor converges to median.

known_hits.note: PlatinAI 4-cell synthetic IC50 from HOMO/LUMO/Gap/Polarizability — bounded [4,8] with heavy mode near midpoint; R^2 plateau at +0.16 rather than +0.5+.

check_method.step_2: Compute y_train.quantile([0.01, 0.05, 0.5, 0.95, 0.99]). Flag if q95 - q5 < 1.0 (pIC50 units).
check_method.step_3: Train quantile regressor at q=0.5 (median). Flag if median-MAE < mean-MAE by > 20%.

causes.diagnostic_code: from scipy.stats import skew, kurtosis; skew_y = skew(y_train); q_range = np.quantile(y_train, 0.95) - np.quantile(y_train, 0.05)
mitigations: Apply log1p(y) transformation if y > 0 (IC50 in nM).
Apply Yeo-Johnson power transform (handles negatives) before regression.
Stratify training set by y bins; oversample the tails (q < 0.1 and q > 0.9).

causes.title: Hilbert optimizer step too large: inner product overflow leads to NaN, loss = 0
causes.summary: PD step overflows; iterate jumps out of feasible set; loss collapses to 0; gradient becomes NaN.

known_hits.note: Constant lr=0.01 on sparse-RDKit scale (||x|| ~ 400); first PD iterate jumped to ||x_k|| ~ 1e6; inner product overflowed; gradient became NaN; regressor outputted mean for remaining iters.

check_method.step_1: Inspect loss_curve[:10]. Flag if loss[5:] ~ 0 AND loss[:5] is finite.
check_method.step_2: Check np.isnan(grad).any() or np.isinf(grad).any(). Flag if true.
check_method.step_3: Inspect np.linalg.norm(x_k, 2) over iters. Flag if ||x_k|| grows by > 100x in first 5 iters.

causes.expected_signal: loss_curve[5:] == 0 AND np.isnan(grad) somewhere in trajectory
mitigations: Add gradient clipping: grad = grad * min(1, 1.0 / (||grad|| + 1e-8)).
Use warmup-cosine LR schedule: lr_warmup=50, lr_max=0.005, lr_min=0.0005 (Wf-37 fix).
Pad input features with bias column (Wf-37 fix) instead of tile-inflate.
Switch to float64 for Hilbert inner product; cast back to float32 only for final prediction.

causes.title: Numerical precision: float32 leads to R-squared noise floor plus-minus 0.05
causes.summary: Float32 Hilbert inner product accumulates error; R^2 has noise floor +/- 0.05 to +/- 0.5.

known_hits.note: Hilbert R^2 = -1.4252 on one seed; R^2 std = 0.6802 across 5 seeds; consistent with +/- 0.5 R^2 noise floor at hilbert_dim=64 in float32.

check_method.step_1: Compute R^2.std() across 5+ seeds. Flag if R^2.std() > 0.5 * |R^2.mean()|.
check_method.step_2: Re-run same seed in float64. Flag if |R^2_fp32 - R^2_fp64| > 0.1.
check_method.step_3: Re-run with hilbert_dim=128. Flag if R^2(128) ~ R^2(64) — dim is not bottleneck.

causes.diagnostic_code: r2_scores = [train_one_seed(s) for s in range(5)]; noise_ratio = np.std(r2_scores) / max(abs(np.mean(r2_scores)), 1e-8)
mitigations: Use float64 for Hilbert inner product (hot loop small enough that wall cost is acceptable).
Report R^2.mean() +/- R^2.std() honestly; do not cherry-pick seeds.
Re-run with seeds=[0..9]; require R^2.mean() > 0.0 AND R^2.mean() > 2 * R^2.std() for positive ship.

causes.title: Feature-target correlation truly weak: ASTSR features weakly correlated with IC50
causes.summary: All Causes 1-7 ruled out; features fundamentally cannot carry the signal.

known_hits.note: ASTSR 12-d RDKit features weakly correlated with Pt binding affinity at scaffold-level split; upper bound ~+0.5 requires 3D / electronic descriptors not in current 12-d set.

check_method.step_1: Compute information-theoretic upper bound: R^2_max = 1 - H(y_test) / log(N_test). Flag if R^2_max < 0.2.
check_method.step_2: Compute ridge baseline on same train/test split. Flag if ridge_R^2 < 0.
check_method.step_3: Compute per-target Spearman rho with best 3-d feature subset (greedy forward selection). Flag if max |rho| < 0.05.

causes.diagnostic_code: from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge; ridge_r2 = Ridge().fit(X_train, y_train).score(X_test, y_test)
mitigations: Augment features with 3D conformer descriptors (after MMFF94s relax).
Add metal-specific descriptors: Pt-N_bond_length, trans_effect_angle, coordination_geometry.
If dataset too small (< 100), augment with PlatinAI synthetic data ONLY for training (never for test).

cross_cause_interactions.explanation: Baseline collapse (C1) + PD step overflow (C6) + 8-d features against binary target (C2).
Baseline collapse (C1) + PlatinAI/HeLa48h cohort mismatch (C4) + 12-d features against synthetic IC50 (C2).
PlatinAI 4-cell concentrated target (C5) + weak feature-target correlation (C8); +0.16 is ship acceptable.
Float32 noise floor (C7) + AST branch baseline collapse (C1); composite branch rescues ship.

phase_2_execution_order: Re-measure Wf-32 m16 in float64 (C7 check) + Wf-37 L5 setup on same seed. If R^2 >= 0, C7 is dominant noise.
Inspect Wf-32 trainer for target normalization (C3) and cohort split (C4). If found, fix and re-run.
Re-split PlatinAI 4-cell by strict scaffold (C4 mitigation) and re-train.
If all above fail: Phase 3 ships C2 / C8 mitigation (3D + electronic features).
phase_2_exit_criterion: At least one Wf-32 m16 cohort hits Pearson r >= 0.0 AND R^2 >= 0.0 on real spread pIC50 (no synthetic).
lit_anchors: Sun & Zheng 2026 — 数学学报 53(4): 821-846 — Hilbert PD O(1/k) bound.
Chambolle & Pock 2011 — J. Math. Imaging Vision 40(1): 120-145 — canonical PD reference.
Bemis & Murcko 1996 — J. Med. Chem. 39(15): 2887-2893 — Bemis-Murcko scaffold split.
Wu et al. 2018 — Molecules 23(6): 1379 — MoleculeNet scaffold split caveats.
Pedregosa et al. 2011 — JMLR 12: 2825-2830 — scikit-learn ridge baseline.

honest_framing.r2_negative_not_always_bug: If C8 trips after C1-C7 are ruled out, ship negative R^2 as known limitation.
